title: feat(cutkuniq): coverage is unique only at k=4,6,8 and the maximizer is f1
science: The strongest forcing negative against L1 in the entire batch, and the natural terminal of the coverage lane. Ranking all 32 F_cut maps by cov_k for k=1,5,6,7,8,9,10,11 (plus cited k=2,3,4) gives the uniqueness set K_unique={4,6,8} - the only seed sizes at which the coverage maximizer is unique - and at EVERY one of them the unique maximizer is f1=(1,1,1,1,1), never f_L1. The margins are explicit
